inv.location: Santa Cristina - San Rafael, Cruz de Humilladero, Málaga
inv.desc_es:
Excelente local en venta. Actualmente está funcionando como centro de belleza, peluquería y centro de formación. Cuenta con distintas salas: estética con trastero, amplia zona de peluquería donde se encuentran actualmente seis tocadores y cuatro lavacabezas, sala de formación y dos aseos. Mobiliario opcional. Además cuenta con salida de humos por si desea otro tipo de negocio o totalmente reformado para continuar el negocio o cualquier otro. Excelente ubicación, rodeado de comercios de todo tipo y muy bien comunicado, junto a la Av. Ortega y Gasset.

inv.desc_en:
Excellent premises for sale. It is currently operating as a beauty center, hair salon, and training center. It features various rooms: an aesthetics room with a storage area, a spacious hair salon area currently equipped with six styling stations and four washbasins, a training room, and two restrooms. Furniture is optional. It also has a smoke vent in case you wish to open a different type of business, and it is fully renovated to continue the current business or any other. Excellent location, surrounded by all kinds of shops and very well connected, next to Av. Ortega y Gasset.
Request your visit ❗.
In compliance with the Decree of the Regional Government of Andalusia 218/2005 of October 11, the client is informed that notary fees, registration fees, ITP (Property Transfer Tax), and other expenses inherent to the sale are not included in the price. Agency fees are included.
